meta.title: Take a short break
meta.context: An adult learner has been reviewing a report for hours and is planning a short pause before the next meeting.
meta.concept: Practice a useful workplace exchange and distinguish resting from continuing to work.

lines.speaker: 同事
lines.text: 我们休息一下吧。 (Wǒmen xiūxi yíxià ba.) — Let’s take a short break.

lines.speaker: 你
lines.text: 好，我去倒杯水。 (Hǎo, wǒ qù dào bēi shuǐ.) — Sure, I’ll get a glass of water.

sections.title: Pause or continue?

items.label: 休息 (xiūxi)
items.text: Rest or take a break from an activity.

items.label: 工作 (gōngzuò)
items.text: Work; continue with a job or task.

sections.text: The two words describe different parts of a workday, so notice which action the situation calls for.

sections.title: Recall in context
sections.prompt: Your screen has been open for hours and you want to pause. What can you say?
sections.answer: 我们休息一下吧。 (Wǒmen xiūxi yíxià ba.) — Let’s take a short break.

sections.title: A useful pattern
sections.text: 休息一下 (xiūxi yíxià) means “rest for a bit” or “take a short break.” Add 一下 (yíxià) to make the suggestion sound light and brief.

sources.title: 汉典: 休息
sources.note: Lists the reading as xiū xī and defines the term as rest or a pause in activity.
